model_annotation: The chart is a comparative donut chart illustrating the relative shares of various sectors in the German budget for the years 2014 and 2021. The chart is divided into two concentric rings, with the inner ring representing the year 2014 and the outer ring representing the year 2021. Each sector is represented by a slice in the chart, with the size of the slice indicating the proportion of the budget allocated to that sector. The sectors are labeled and color-coded for easy identification. The chart includes a legend that matches the colors of the slices to their respective sectors. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and there are no percentage labels inside the slices. The chart does not include any visual indications of the order of the slices, such as descending size.
